# VERITÉ (25 · verite)

A film studio on real film — live grain and scratches, letterboxed title card, rolling credits.

- **Technique:** LIVE FILM GRAIN
- **Tags:** film, cinema, dark, grain, studio, moody, classic
- **Best for:** film studios; production companies; photographers; film festivals
- **Fonts:** Playfair Display, Archivo Narrow
- **Fonts href:** `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,700;1,400;1,500&family=Archivo+Narrow:wght@400;500;600&display=swap`
- **Swatch:** #0c0b09 · #d8d5cd · #d9a94f
- **Dependencies:** none beyond the shared helpers
- **Source:** `src/templates/verite/` (Template.astro, content.ts, grain.ts, meta.ts, scenes.ts, style.css, theme.css)

## Signature effects
- `grain.ts`
  - `initGrain(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement)` — Live film grain, occasional vertical scratches and dust on a half-resolution fullscreen canvas.
- `scenes.ts`
  - `initScenes(frames: Iterable<HTMLElement>)` — Draw each `[data-scene]` frame's duotone illustration (prepended, so the caption stays on top).

## Content model — `content.ts`
Every user-visible string lives here. Fields ending in `Html` are trusted inline HTML (`<em> <b> <i> <br> <a> <span>`).

```ts
/** Fields ending in `Html` are trusted, author-written HTML (inline <em>/<b>/<i>/<a>/<br> only). */
export interface Link {
  label: string;
  href: string;
}

/** Duotone scene drawn into a film frame by scenes.ts. */
export type SceneKind = 'lighthouse' | 'window' | 'road' | 'sea';

export interface Film {
  scene: SceneKind;
  title: string;
  /** Right-hand caption, e.g. "1971 · 96 MIN". */
  meta: string;
}

/** One rolling-credits entry: small amber role over a large serif name. */
export interface Credit {
  role: string;
  name: string;
}

export interface Content {
  seo: { title: string; description: string; ogTitle?: string; ogDescription?: string };
  /** Wordmark in nav + footer, e.g. `VERIT<i>É</i>` (the <i> is the amber italic accent). */
  wordmarkHtml: string;
  nav: Link[];
  hero: {
    /** Top letterbox bar label (left). */
    reel: string;
    /** Bottom letterbox bar label (right). */
    runtime: string;
    pre: string;
    headingHtml: string;
    sub: string;
    foot: string;
  };
  films: {
    kicker: string;
    headingHtml: string;
    items: Film[];
    note: string;
  };
  method: {
    kicker: string;
    /** Blockquote body including its typographic quotes. */
    quoteHtml: string;
    cite: string;
  };
  credits: {
    /** aria-label of the rolling-credits region. */
    label: string;
    /** Credits in roll order. */
    entries: Credit[];
  };
  footer: {
    noteHtml: string;
    creditHtml: string;
  };
  /** Showcase-only chrome; rendered when the template's `showcase` prop is true. */
  showcase?: {
    chipLabel: string;
    chipHref: string;
    footerHtml: string;
    /** Closing credit, set after a gap at the end of the roll. */
    credit: Credit;
  };
}
```
